cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Act Authorized
cards.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Enter our rehearsal as confirmed, please. The approval stamp is on the request; we're at the calendar stage now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I process approvals. You enter the approved booking. Date, room, confirmed; please keep to those fields.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager checks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: 'Held' sends her another approval request. Use 'confirmed,' please. Let's not ask her to redo a completed stage.
